Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync — Snowflake/Databricks + vector DB joint announcement planning. Need 3 things: marketplace listing readiness, certified connector matrix (qdrant/pinecone/milvus), and a hardware compatibility note for DGX customers. Who can own each?
Eli (Eng): I can take the connector cert matrix. Will need compatibility test harness from SI team. ETA Tues.
Jonah (Product): I'll own the marketplace listing copy + screenshots. Need final model variant and pricing tiers by EOD Mon.
Sasha (Field Eng): I can put together the DGX/hardware compatibility note + perf numbers. Quick Q: do we include 8K vs 32K seq baselines?
Maya (Partnerships): Yes include both, call out expected throughput and per-token cost delta. Also add known quantization caveats.
Raj (Partner Eng): I'll coordinate with Snowflake PM on their listing checklist and legal for co-branded assets. @Jonah can you share draft copy early tomorrow?
Jonah (Product): Yep — will drop a draft in this thread by 9am. Also adding a short FAQ: "Does this work in Snowpark?" and "What auth flows are supported?"
Eli (Eng): For cert matrix: need a matrix columns: connector version, vector DB distro, schema mapping supported, throughput (qps), max payload size, test script link. Example snippet for test runner:
```
./run_integration_test --connector qdrant --model redwood-xl-8k --seq 8192 --batch 16
```
Maya (Partnerships): Good. Raj — can you confirm whether Snow wants a signed SOW for marketplace listing or if the co-marketing agreement is sufficient?
Raj (Partner Eng): Snow asked for a co-marketing LOA for joint press. SOW only for paid pilots. Filing ticket with legal now.
Sasha (Field Eng): Quick note from HW: DGX A100 shows 1.8x throughput vs V100 for 32k with our optimizations; I'll attach perf CSV to the doc. Also flag memory workarounds for 32k KV cache.
marketplace-bot: (automated) New doc created: /partnerships/marketplace-listing-drafts/1755054321-snow-dbx-vector-integration-draft.md
Maya (Partnerships): Nice — let's aim for announcement target next Friday. Action list: Eli (cert matrix by Tue), Jonah (listing draft by Mon 9am), Sasha (perf note + CSV by Tue), Raj (legal LOA by Tue EOD). I'll run the announcement playbook once we have assets.
Eli (Eng): ACK. Will push test artifacts to /eng-integrations/qc/175505 and reference them in the matrix.
Jonah (Product): ACK — will include 2 screenshots (console flow + quickstart) and a short 60s demo script.
Maya (Partnerships): If anyone runs into blockers, ping me + @Raj immediately. Thanks team :rocket:
